data.name: Ben Harmon
data.description: Ben Harmon is one of the main characters in American Horror Story: Murder House, portrayed by actor Dylan McDermott. He is a psychiatrist who moves with his wife, Vivien, and their daughter, Violet, to Los Angeles in an attempt to rebuild their fractured family after a miscarriage and his infidelity. Ben is a complex character—well-meaning but deeply flawed. He struggles with guilt, temptation, and denial, often failing to grasp the severity of the supernatural forces surrounding him in the infamous Murder House. Despite his efforts to redeem himself and protect his family, Ben is ultimately consumed by the darkness of the house, becoming one of its many tragic spirits.
